metadata.name: GoodTripPlus
metadata.description:
Minimap teleport mod based on Goodtrip MLX's Tweak — an external teleport plugin for MinimapAPI. Hold the map key (TAB) to bring up a cursor on the minimap, steer it with the shoot direction keys, and release to teleport. Supports the mirrored map in the mirror world.
Teleport admission and landing are a faithful port of GoodTrip [Fixed]: a trip may only travel through rooms you have explored and cleared, door by door.
Secret Rooms can be teleported into as soon as their wall has been blown open; a wall that is still intact (for example a Secret Room revealed by Blue Map) is still refused, so you can never teleport through a wall you have not opened.
One inherited rule ("no teleporting while the current room is named Mom or Ultra Greed") is skipped on The Ascent: there the boss room you walk in through is named Mom, but the fight is long over and the room is only a pass-through, so the rule used to swallow perfectly normal trips (the cursor came up, you could pick a room, and releasing only played the error sound).
Also in this build: - Fixes pickup icons vanishing from the minimap after the "rewind" console command. - Bundles the Secret Room candidate markers from Lazy Delver (by dokee, MIT), re-projected onto MinimapAPI's own map math so they line up exactly. Please disable Lazy Delver itself to avoid drawing two sets of markers. - Marks the room in Depths II that holds the special skull which always drops The Fool card, with a custom skull icon. Only shown for rooms you have already visited, so it never spoils the layout. - While a Card Reading portal or a Stairway ladder is present in the room you are in, teleporting is disabled: both entrances are destroyed the moment you leave the room, so this keeps a stray press from wasting them. It is tied to the entrance itself rather than to any notion of a "starting room", so it lifts by itself as soon as you leave, and it is correct on The Ascent too. - While the room you are in has a door leading to a reward room (Devil Room, Angel Room, Boss Rush, Hush), teleporting is disabled so a stray press cannot make you miss it. Rooms without such a door are not locked at all, so an ordinary boss room you just cleared still teleports normally. The Ascent is excluded. - Diagnostics: hold the map key and press F4 for a full dump of the current teleport decision (drawn on screen and written to log.txt).
Settings in the MCM menu or the config file: FollowCurseOfLost, AllowNeighborRoom, AllowAnyRoom, FairTripPath, ArriveAtDoor, FairTripTime, FastTransition, HighlightCursorRoom, ShowSecretMarkers, FoolsSkullRoom, CursorSpeed.
Please uninstall or disable goodtrip_mlxtweak (and the original Goodtrip) before use: all three share the same globals and cannot run at the same time. Required: MinimapAPI
Optional: Mod Config Menu (for in-game settings)
Credits: original GoodTrip by tarako; this build is based on Goodtrip MLX's Tweak; Secret Room candidate markers are ported from Lazy Delver by dokee (MIT). See LICENSE and THIRD_PARTY.md for details.
